topic: Ignoring a child's stolen social security number vs freezing a minor's credit (Malcolm vs Junie)

scenes.narration: Thieves love a child's clean social security number. Court is in session!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera at the bench holding a card labeled CHILD SOCIAL SECURITY NUMBER, a shadowy hand reaching for it, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Malcolm and Junie each have a newborn daughter this year.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man malcolm and woman junie holding newborn daughters, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Both numbers are stolen in the same clinic data breach.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a clinic computer screen stamped DATA BREACH with files flying out, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Malcolm assumes children cannot have credit, so he does nothing.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man malcolm shrugging beside a thought bubble reading KIDS CANNOT HAVE CREDIT, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: A thief opens cards and a car loan in her name.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a shadowy figure approved for cards and a car loan under a child's name, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Nobody notices for sixteen years, until she applies for aid.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a teenage girl at a college desk receiving a denial letter, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Her file shows forty thousand dollars in defaulted debt.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a credit report unrolling with a total reading FORTY THOUSAND DEFAULTED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Junie freezes her daughter's credit at every bureau, for free.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman junie at a laptop with three padlock icons labeled with credit bureaus, a tag reading FREE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: A frozen file cannot be used to open new accounts.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a credit file behind a padlocked steel door stamped FROZEN, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The same thief tries and is rejected instantly.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a shadowy figure at a screen reading APPLICATION DENIED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: One family cleans up for years. One lost nothing.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel, man malcolm buried in dispute letters, woman junie calm with a padlocked file, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Freeze your child's credit at all three bureaus. It is free. Court dismissed!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera banging her gavel beside a banner reading FREEZE YOUR CHILD CREDIT, kids comic book illustration
